- People: Bram, Greta, Ada, Leon active. Una out; Dell covering.
- Status: Bram prefers library annex. Leon wants Garden studio clear for visitors.
- Locations/Noise: East wing (morning, repainting/noise), Harbour room (morning, repainting/noise), Library annex (evening, repainting/noise), Garden studio (afternoon, repainting/noise), Print room (evening, repainting/noise), Loading bay (evening, repainted).

- Temp/Cold: Loading bay (morning, Una), North office (evening Kira, afternoon Finn/Vik), Harbour room (afternoon/evening Mira) cold.
- Umbrellas: Left in East wing, Garden studio, Loading bay, Library annex, North office.
- Tasks: Send notes to Nils, Jonah, Teo, Bram, Finn, Hugo, Kira, Ada, Mira, Pia. Clear harbour room, Garden studio, and North office for visitors.
- Meetings: Morning stand-up in north office. Afternoon stand-up in harbour room. Evening stand-up moved to **north office**.
- Accounts: Quinmore overdraft 1,550. Quinnick limit 9,225. Iststead mileage 5,700; fuel 6,250. Dovton pallet 4,825.
- Updates: Coffee machines working (Loading bay, Print room confirmed working).
